12137|c087faab.name: Squibby Overspeck
12137|c087faab.text: Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?

1387|c5ceacbe.name: Thysta
1387|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3149|ae6d6ab0.name: Nez'raz
3149|ae6d6ab0.text: Why you would want to leave these sunny shores and crystal blue waters I have no idea. It's like paradise down here. But don't tell my brother Zapetta that, he's bitter enough already about getting stuck up there in Tirisfal all day long. This Zeppelin here drops off at Orgrimmar so you shouldn't have to worry about having to listen to him whine. But if you are in Tirisfal anytime soon, heed my warning and don't get him started.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

5814|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Thulbek
5814|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

96774-accept.name: Mazu'kon
96774-accept.text:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774-accept.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

99197-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99197-progress.text:
The Windshapers presently find ourselves in need of silk cloth. If you could spare sixty pieces of silk then we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A fine gift such as silk would certainly increase your honor and esteem amongst the Windshapers!

If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99197-progress.title: A Donation of Silk
